National Special Projects Office 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Uttar Pradesh · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/17/2022/113 
 Dated: 31 Mar 2026 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Ring Road - Uttar Pradesh Pkg-113" (expressways), awarded to M/s
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in
 all respects on 10 Jul 2022 at a gross executed value of INR 200.00 Cr (Rupees 200.00 Crore Only).
 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
 workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Priya Patel. This certificate is issued for record and for
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 National Special Projects Office
